finding.text: reviewer failed to run: fetch failed

Old card links land on an empty page (requirement 4). `public/index.html` rewrites `/framework/ai2/YYYY/MM/DD/<slug>/` to `/framework/ai/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/<slug>/`, but a card's page is `/framework/ai/YYYY/MM/DD/<slug>/` (`CardDir.page()`, `ai/cards/CardDir.js:31`; every other link this diff rewrites uses that form). Headless proof: `/framework/ai/sessions/2026/09/24/system-design/` draws a bare "system-design · No tasks recorded under this folder", while `/framework/ai/2026/09/24/system-design/` draws the real System design card. `check.mjs` tested only a session folder (`2026/10/20/session-e00f55c9/`), which happens to exist at the sessions path, so it missed this. Fix: send dated ids to `/framework/ai/` + day, with no `sessions/`, and add one real dated card url to `check.mjs`.

There is no report with output (Done means). The brief asks for every check "in your report, with output". The task folder holds the scripts (`check.mjs`, `chat-proof.mjs`, `lines-check.mjs`, `urls.mjs`, `manifest.json`) but no record of what they printed. So requirement 1 (are the 295 lines in the store?) has no answer anywhere a fresh agent can read. Write `report.md` in the task folder with each script's output.

It is not merged yet, so "the folder is gone on compliance/dev" is not yet true: `ls public/framework/ai2` still lists 23 files on the main tree. Expected at review time, but the brief says don't report done before the merge. Land it with `merge.mjs` once fix 1 is in.

One historical page still reads a file from the deleted folder: `ai/sessions/2026/09/24/1c09793f-…/servex-mastermind/page.js:14`, `files(import.meta, "../../../ai2/doc/card-standard.md …")`. That card's file list will show a missing file. Point it at `ai/doc/ai2/`, or leave it and note it in the archive readme.

Mechanical rewrites left some code that no longer says anything. `Server/Crawl.mjs:75-80`: both branches of the if now add the same route. `Servex/agents/Layers.js:520` reads "(`/framework/ai/<card id>/`, not the old `/framework/ai/` board page)". `Server/Ai2Overview.mjs` still names the concept "AI 2", with id `ai2`. `Servex/agents/Assistant.js:343` and `ai/dashboard/page.js:124` still name `ai2/` files.

The redirect sends `/framework/ai2/needs/` to `/framework/ai/inbox/`. The old Needs view is now the rail's "Needs you" chip, so this is the closest page, but the choice isn't written in the archive readme.

Requirement 1 is not answered for most of the 295 lines. `lines-check.mjs` reads git at `fa90c3a41^`, which holds 72 lines in 19 files. The audit's 295 come mostly from gitignored card logs: 240 from `ai/2026/10/13/session-730e8a7b/page.jsonl` and 33 from `session-f155ecbd` (audit.md:78, move-plan.md table). Git never held these files, and the worktree has none of them. In the main tree, `sessions/2026/10/13/cards/session-730e8a7b/page.jsonl` has 284 lines (44 + 240), so the lines are probably there. But nothing proves it. result.md says "Missing: 0" for "295 audit lines". Rerun `ai2-retire/audit-ai2.mjs` in the main tree, as the brief asked, and record its output.

The archive readme contradicts itself and the code. `ai/archive/ai2/readme.md`, bullet 3, says `/framework/ai2/YYYY/MM/DD/…` goes to `/framework/ai/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/…`. The paragraph under it, and `public/index.html`, send a dated card to `/framework/ai/YYYY/MM/DD/<card>/`. Delete the bullet; the paragraph is correct.

"Done means" asks for each check with its output. result.md gives conclusions but no output for `ls public/framework/ai2` failing, for the import search, or for the headless `/framework/ai2/` check. It is also not merged: "the folder is gone on compliance/dev" is still false, and the brief says not to report done before the merge. It also doesn't list what was closed (the brief asks for zero footprint).

The brief says "Commit the script beside `public/framework/ai/readme.md`" for the folder map, but no map script sits there. Only `skills.mjs` is in `public/framework/ai/`. The readme links the sibling task's `findings.md` instead. Either move or copy the script next to the readme, or say in result.md why the findings link is enough.

`ai/local/page.js:13` `REPORT_URL` changed from one dead address to another. `/framework/ai/2026-10-01/local-ai/` has a hyphenated date, so no route matches it. The report is at `ai/sessions/2026/09/24/servex-mastermind-opus/local-ai/`.

Stale comments still name `ai2/` files as if they exist: `Servex/agents/Assistant.js:54,343`; `ai/dashboard/page.js:22,24,124`; `core/Page/ext/Inbox/servex.js:3`; `ext/Refine/prompt-card.js:28,32`; `ext/drawer/tabs.js:29`. `Server/Ai2Overview.mjs` still names the concept "AI 2". The history page `sessions/2026/09/24/1c09793f…/servex-mastermind/page.js:14` still lists `../../../ai2/doc/card-standard.md`, so its file list shows a missing file.

The shots come from before the second review's text fixes. `ux/Card` at 400 still shows "opened at /framework/ai/ or /framework/ai/", and the current diff replaces that line. So the shots prove the layout didn't change, but they don't show the final text.
